@@ -10728,6 +10747,28 @@ SATI is encoded in the OP-IMM-32 major opcode and is available only in RV64.
 
 ===== Operation
 
+RV32:
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+n  = uimm5[4:0]
+
+minval = 0xFFFF_FFFF << n
+maxval = ~minval
+
+if (s1 <_s minval):
+    vxsat = 1
+    X[rd] = minval
+else if (s1 >_s maxval):
+    vxsat = 1
+    X[rd] = maxval
+else:
+    X[rd] = s1
+----
+
+RV64:
+
 [source,pseudocode]
 ----
 s1 = X[rs1]
